topQueriesAllPhases.query: SELECT h.*, a.name AS "_addressName", r.id AS "_roundId", r.completed AS "_completed", r.completed_date AS "_completedDate", r.end_date AS "_endDate", r.leave_letter AS "_leaveLetter" FROM (SELECT "t"."id" AS "id","t"."number" AS "number","t"."legend" AS "legend","t"."dont_visit" AS "dontVisit","t"."complement" AS "complement","t"."order" AS "order","t"."address_id" AS "addressId","t"."block_id" AS "blockId","t"."registration_status" AS "registrationStatus","t"."territory_block_address_id" AS "territoryBlockAddressId" FROM "house" AS "t" WHERE "t"."tenant_id"=$1 AND "t"."territory_id"=$2 AND "t"."block_id" IN ($3) AND "t"."registration_status" <> $4 AND "t"."number" <> $5 AND ("t"."territory_block_address_id" IS NULL OR "t"."territory_block_address_id" IN ($6,$7,$8))) h JOIN address a ON a.id=h."addressId" LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id,completed,completed_date,end_date,leave_letter FROM round WHERE house_id=h.id AND round_number=$9 ORDER BY id LIMIT $10) r ON $11

SELECT "t"."can_edit_structure" AS "canEditStructure","t"."id" AS "id","t"."key" AS "key","t"."expiration_date" AS "expirationDate","t"."token" AS "token","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId" FROM "signature" AS "t" WHERE "t"."key"=$1 AND "t"."tenant_id"=$2 AND "t"."expiration_date">$3 LIMIT $4

SELECT "t"."registration_status" AS "registrationStatus","t"."id" AS "id","t"."block_id" AS "blockId","t"."territory_id" AS "territoryId","t"."signature_id" AS "signatureId","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId" FROM "territory_block" AS "t" WHERE "t"."tenant_id"=$1 AND "t"."territory_id"=$2 AND "t"."block_id"=$3 AND "t"."registration_status" <> $4 LIMIT $5

SELECT h.*,
      json_build_object($5,b.id,$6,b.name) AS block,
      CASE WHEN s.id IS NULL THEN $7 ELSE json_build_object($8,s.key,$9,s.expiration_date,$10,s.token) END AS signature,
      coalesce((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object($11,m.id,$12,m.registration_status,$13,m.territory_block_id,$14,m.address_id,$15,m.tenant_id,
        $16,json_build_object($17,a.id,$18,a.name,$19,a.tenant_id,$20,a.zip_code)) ORDER BY m.id)
        FROM territory_block_address m JOIN address a ON a.id=m.address_id WHERE m.territory_block_id=h.id AND m.registration_status<>$21), $22::json) AS territory_block_address
      FROM (SELECT "t"."registration_status" AS "registrationStatus","t"."id" AS "id","t"."block_id" AS "blockId","t"."territory_id" AS "territoryId","t"."signature_id" AS "signatureId","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId" FROM "territory_block" AS "t" WHERE "t"."tenant_id"=$1 AND "t"."territory_id"=$2 AND "t"."registration_status" <> $3 AND "t"."block_id"=$4 ORDER BY (SELECT "o"."name" FROM "block" AS "o" WHERE "o"."id"="t"."block_id") ASC) h JOIN block b ON b.id=h."blockId" LEFT JOIN signature s ON s.id=h."signatureId"

SELECT "t"."id" AS "id","t"."name" AS "name","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId","t"."type_id" AS "typeId","t"."image_url" AS "imageUrl" FROM "territory" AS "t" WHERE "t"."id"=$1 AND "t"."tenant_id"=$2 LIMIT $3

SELECT DISTINCT fs.client_id,fs.block_id,fs.address_id FROM field_session fs JOIN signature s ON s.key=fs.signature_key AND s.tenant_id=fs.tenant_id WHERE fs.tenant_id=$1 AND fs.territory_id=$2 AND fs.round_number=$3 AND fs.last_seen_at>now()-interval $5 AND fs.disconnected_at IS NULL AND s.expiration_date>now() AND fs.block_id=$4

INSERT INTO field_session(tenant_id,territory_id,round_number,block_id,address_id,client_id,tab_id,signature_key) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,client_id,tab_id) WHERE disconnected_at IS NULL DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at=now()
SELECT round_number,revision FROM field_revision WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND territory_id=$2 AND block_id=$3 AND round_number IN ($5,$4)

SELECT "t"."status" AS "status","t"."type_ids" AS "typeIds","t"."started_at" AS "startedAt","t"."closed_at" AS "closedAt","t"."id" AS "id","t"."round_number" AS "roundNumber","t"."name" AS "name","t"."theme" AS "theme","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId","t"."color_primary" AS "colorPrimary","t"."color_secondary" AS "colorSecondary","t"."type" AS "type" FROM "round_info" AS "t" WHERE "t"."tenant_id"=$1 AND "t"."round_number"=$2 LIMIT $3

UPDATE field_session SET disconnected_at=LEAST(now(),last_seen_at+interval $8) WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND client_id=$2 AND tab_id=$3 AND disconnected_at IS NULL AND (last_seen_at<=now()-interval $9 OR signature_key<>$4 OR block_id IS DISTINCT FROM $5::integer OR address_id IS DISTINCT FROM $6::integer OR round_number<>$7)

SELECT json_build_object($1,count(*) FILTER(WHERE state=$2),$3,count(*) FILTER(WHERE state=$4),$5,count(*),$6,count(*) FILTER(WHERE wait_event_type=$7),$8,(SELECT count(DISTINCT client_id) FROM field_session WHERE disconnected_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at>now()-interval $9 AND client_id~$10),$11,(SELECT count(DISTINCT tenant_id) FROM field_session WHERE disconnected_at IS NULL AND last_seen_at>now()-interval $12 AND client_id~$13)) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database()
SELECT "t"."id" AS "id","t"."name" AS "name","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId" FROM "type" AS "t" WHERE ($2 AND "t"."id" IN ($1))

UPDATE round SET 
        update_date = $1, 
        completed = $2, 
        completed_date = $3 
      WHERE house_id = $4 AND round_number = $5

SELECT "t"."id" AS "id","t"."key" AS "key","t"."value" AS "value","t"."description" AS "description","t"."tenant_id" AS "tenantId" FROM "parameter" AS "t" WHERE "t"."tenant_id"=$1 AND "t"."key"=$2 LIMIT $3
BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED
SELECT "t"."id" AS "id","t"."name" AS "name","t"."image_url" AS "imageUrl" FROM "territory" AS "t" WHERE "t"."id"=$1 AND "t"."tenant_id"=$2 LIMIT $3
SELECT "t"."name" AS "name","t"."city" AS "city","t"."state" AS "state","t"."phone" AS "phone","t"."id" AS "id" FROM "multi_tenancy" AS "t" WHERE "t"."id"=$1 LIMIT $2

SELECT "public"."territory_block"."id", "public"."territory_block"."registration_status", "public"."territory_block"."block_id", "public"."territory_block"."territory_id", "public"."territory_block"."signature_id", "public"."territory_block"."tenant_id" FROM "public"."territory_block" WHERE ("public"."territory_block"."tenant_id" = $1 AND "public"."territory_block"."territory_id" = $2 AND "public"."territory_block"."block_id" = $3 AND "public"."territory_block"."registration_status" <> $4) LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6

SELECT "t"."id" AS "id","t"."entity" AS "entity","t"."action" AS "action","t"."target_id" AS "targetId" FROM "change_request" AS "t" WHERE "t"."tenant_id"=$1 AND "t"."territory_id"=$2 AND "t"."status"=$3 AND "t"."block_id"=$4
COMMIT
BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ
SELECT json_build_object($1,coalesce(sum(calls),$2),$3,coalesce(sum(total_exec_time),$4)) FROM pg_stat_statements

SELECT "public"."signature"."id", "public"."signature"."can_edit_structure", "public"."signature"."key", "public"."signature"."expiration_date", "public"."signature"."token", "public"."signature"."tenant_id" FROM "public"."signature" WHERE ("public"."signature"."key" = $1 AND "public"."signature"."tenant_id" = $2 AND "public"."signature"."expiration_date" > $3) LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5

SELECT "public"."house"."id", "public"."house"."registration_status", "public"."house"."number", "public"."house"."dont_visit", "public"."house"."block_id", "public"."house"."address_id", "public"."house"."territory_id", "public"."house"."territory_block_address_id", "public"."house"."phone", "public"."house"."legend", "public"."house"."complement", "public"."house"."order", "public"."house"."observations", "public"."house"."report_type", "public"."house"."backup_data", "public"."house"."tenant_id" FROM "public"."house" WHERE ("public"."house"."id" = $1 AND $4=$5) LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
